title: Unknown or unforeseen procedure transaction identity or PDU Session identity

entities.name: Procedure Transaction Identity
entities.description: Identifier used to distinguish between different procedure transactions in the 5G NAS protocol.

entities.name: PDU Session Identity
entities.description: Identifier used to distinguish between different PDU sessions in the 5G NAS protocol.

entities.name: Unknown or unforeseen identifier condition
entities.description: Condition that occurs when a procedure transaction identity or PDU session identity is not recognized by the receiving entity.
